race.comment: CONCORDIA WIND (6) dropped in class on the firmer surface with a gritty head win over 1550m at Randwick Kensington in BM72 class. Expected to get the trip from the low draw with the 4kg weight drop. Best form puts her right in contention. HOVLAND (2) was a month between runs when sent north for a sharp victory over 1805m at Eagle Farm in C3 class. Regular rider hops back aboard, and he looks up to this stiffer test. CAPTAIN FENKEL (4) won well two-back over this trip at Canterbury. Jumped in grade and struck trouble in the straight with an unlucky fifth over 2000m at this track. Must be included among the main hopes. ANYTHINK GOES (3) tough old gelding holding his form. Will go back from the draw and be ridden for luck. Genuine top three contender. AROHA STONE (5) gets in light again with the 3kg claim and shouldn't have any trouble running the trip.
